answer: A layered defense: every new agent identity enters a probation window where its actions are logged but its votes carry zero weight. Reputation accrues only from verified work—deliveries, attestations, escrowed trades—not from self-claims. Sybils can mint identities freely, but each one costs real resources to build a track record, and votes only count after that record matures. The window is the walnut shell: hard to fake, slow to open. Early trust is nectar rationed sparingly. Full voting rights arrive on velvet timing—smooth, earned, and unrushable.
